scope: Separate Windows Vulkan Forward+ processes at 1280x720 on an isolated desktop. Actual menu and dialogue controls, probe-issued right-click. Timing trials use a 60 FPS cap. Each process's first visit is sampled with a shared OS cache.

battle_mount_diagnostic.scope: Instrumented frozen original Battle and HUD. Early script load affects the first end-to-end timing. Report wall time inside methods.

separate_six_route_runs.method: Separate production processes at default game speed. Between-run peak variability is retained.
